component.name: ReyOS Browser
component.summary: Private-by-default web browser built for ReyOS

description.p: ReyOS Browser is a native Qt WebEngine browser with a private, session-only profile by default, built-in Shields filtering, reader mode, download management, and saved-password support.
This Flatpak packaging is intended for running the browser outside ReyOS while preserving the same application behavior and visual identity.

screenshot.caption: New tab — private by default, no account required
